related_questions.question: What are the gastrointestinal manifestations of COVID-19?

text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 can cause a range of gastrointestinal (GI) symptoms, including nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. These symptoms can be the initial sign of infection or develop later, and may even persist as part of long COVID, according to the University of Nebraska Medical Center. Some individuals may experience GI symptoms as their only indication of COVID-19, according to the University of Nebraska Medical Center. The virus can affect the gut because the receptors it uses to enter cells are also present in the digestive system.
